notes.title: Hazel & The Deep Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Greetings y'all!

Guess we needed to cook more with this one, but we are back with more fixes to make sure players can have the best experience! 

Just let you know we have fixed saving issues, so it could break your older saves.


 About 99% of the voices are fixed (What's left might need retakes)
 A bunch of minor visual glitches have been iron out.
 Some loading errors appearing, now the game will be a lot smoother.


If there are any issues that stop you from enjoy the game, please let us know so we can help as best as we can! Hugs and Kisses!

notes.title: Hazel & The Deep 1.0 HotFix
notes.notes:
After the release we encounter some issue that required our attention, here are the fixes:


Added Cloud Saving( Will affect previous saves).
Fixed Graphical issues in the smut scenes.
Improved voice quality due to heavy cleaning of sound files.
Fixed Several voice issues including repeated voice lines in wrong dialogs.
Fixed and added all gallery elements.
Added several elements of animations throughout the game, including characters and smut scenes.



We like to thank everyone that supported us in buying our game and hope you all have a good day and a fun experience with it. Hugs and Kisses.
